text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rock enters biker-war fray: Public anger prompts meeting with Quebec politicians in bid to stop violence.
- Grade 3 students cramming for test: Ontario project drawing critics.
- Tribunal criticizes Health Canada: Quotas ordered for minorities.
- Summit's outcome rests on Yeltsin: Rapprochement depends on Russian President gaining U.S. concessions on NATO expansion.
- New mammography technique developed: Digital technology allows for better imaging and long-distance consultations.
- Crime, cheap guns join threats to peace: Illicit groups and spread of arms replace hostile states as risks to security, international anaylsts say.
- Reichmanns seek investors: Paul, son Barry to make market debut selling units in nursing home spinoff.
- CIBC eyes stake in R-M Trust: Stock transfer, institutional trust firm seen as strategic aid.
- Bre-X geologist falls from helicopter into Borneo rain forest.
- Canadian airlines stunned by U.S. flight levy.
- Big suppliers bail out of Eaton's debt: Vultures step in as prestige firms wash their hands of retailer's problems.
- Geologist who found Busang dies in chopper fall.
